name: Heritage Foods Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Heritage Foods Ltd is in the business of Dairy, Renewable energy, and Animal feed[1]
keyPoints: Business Overview:[1] [2] Heritage Foods operates dairy business across 13 states, reaching ~1.5 Mn households. The company has 18 processing plants, 2.95 MLPD processing capacity, 2.6 MLPD chilling capacity and 400+ SKUs. Milk sourced from 300,000+ farmers across 9 states.

announcements.text: Sustainability Report For FY 2025-26 30 Oct - Heritage Foods filed its standalone Sustainability Report for FY 2025-26.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release 23 Oct - Heritage Foods approved amalgamation of wholly owned subsidiary Heritage Novandie Foods on October 23, 2026.

Board Meeting Outcome for Amalgamation Of Its Wholly-Owned Subsidiary I.E. Heritage Novandie Foods Limited 23 Oct - Board approved merger of wholly owned subsidiary Heritage Novandie Foods into Heritage Foods on October 23, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome 19 Oct - Heritage Foods released Q2/H1 FY27 earnings call transcript; revenue rose 19% in Q2, PAT was INR309 million.

Update On Acquisition Of Additional 5.60% Equity Share Capital Of M/S. Heritage Novandie Foods Limited 16 Oct - Heritage Foods completed acquisition of remaining 5.60% in HNFL, making it a wholly owned subsidiary.
